parking.overnightBan: No overnight parking on any former Princeton Borough street, 2 to 6 am.
parking.overnightCaveat: Not all streets carry a sign saying so.
parking.rateChange: Meter rates rise on 14 September 2026: 30-minute spaces go from $1.00 to $1.25, and 90-minute zones from $3.00 to $3.50.
parking.note: The 90-minute pay stations start at 10 am. The 15-minute Wawa meters are payable all day, every day.
